goal.objective: Continuously advance or truthfully block the canonical StegNutrition continuation inventory on the resident sovereign heartbeat without requiring another chat session and without any GitHub-token production dependency.
success_predicates: The worker consumes only an already locally materialized StegNutrition tree
The canonical StegNutrition execution inventory is inspected on every admitted heartbeat while unfinished
Fixed deterministic repository validation is executed locally when the target tree is available
Semantic-model, automatic-portion, real benchmark, live TVC route, validation and release gates are projected independently
Every unresolved condition returns an explicit blocker and next executable action
Continuation receipts are fenced, inspectable and persistent
No GitHub token, source checkout credential, hosted model provider or general code-writing authority is required
failure_predicates: The worker fetches StegNutrition from GitHub or requests a GitHub token
A missing locally materialized repository is treated as success
Synthetic benchmark fixtures are represented as real-world accuracy evidence
The low-level visual-evidence model is represented as production semantic food recognition
The worker creates a second heartbeat, route authority, credential authority or model authority
A blocked human-authority or TVC dependency is silently converted to COMPLETE

task.derivation_reason: Durable repository transfer alone does not cause implementation/validation state to advance after chat archival. This task binds the existing StegNutrition inventory to the single resident heartbeat for repeated local progression and explicit blocker observation.

authority.authority_source: StegVerse-Labs/StegNutrition:STEGNUTRITION_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md; credential and route semantics remain TV/TVC

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while unfinished; inspect only locally materialized canonical state and fixed local validation surfaces

completion.next_authorized_action: When all semantic vision, automatic portion, real benchmark, live TVC visual route and fixed local validation predicates are satisfied, emit STEGNUTRITION_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READY. Release/publication remains a separately authorized StegNutrition release task.

block.block_reason: Current product activation depends on locally materialized target state, real semantic/benchmark evidence and resident TVC route observation; each is rechecked by the worker without chat intervention.
block.escalation_condition: Any path attempts GitHub-token source retrieval, hosted model authority, second heartbeat/route authority, or marks unavailable evidence complete
